title: Students and teachers protest living costs in Greek capital
excerpt: Hindustan Times reports that thousands marched in the Greek capital, with similar protests in other Greek cities.
author: LokkeeVerse
content:
Thousands of students and teachers marched through the Greek capital to protest the high cost of living, according to a Hindustan Times headline.

The accompanying source description says similar protests were taking place in several cities across Greece, including Thessaloniki in the north and the western port city of Patras. The supplied metadata does not identify the date of the demonstrations.
seoTitle: Students and teachers march over living costs in Greece
metaDescription: Hindustan Times reports a cost-of-living march by students and teachers in the Greek capital, alongside similar protests in other Greek cities.
